formulas.total_opex: company_owned_expenses + franchised_occupancy + other_restaurant_expenses + sga_depreciation + sga_other + other_operating_income_expense

company_owned_sales_yoy.description: Company-owned restaurant sales YoY growth rate vs Q-4

franchised_revenue_yoy.description: Franchised revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_revenue_yoy.description: Other revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

cost_of_sales_margin_delta_bps.description: Company-owned restaurant expenses as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

franchised_occupancy_margin_delta_bps.description: Franchised occupancy expenses as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

sga_margin_delta_bps.description: SG&A (depreciation and other) as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

other_restaurant_expenses_yoy.description: other_restaurant_expenses YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_operating_income_expense_abs.description: other_operating_income_expense absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

interest_expense_yoy.description: interest_expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

nonoperating_income_expense_abs.description: nonoperating_income_expense absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.
